summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found before proposing anything I did a read-only trace of the full path (client `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` auth middleware → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → DB). The architecture is actually built correctly: - Client sends cookies on every request (`credentials: "include"`). - Watchlist router has its own auth middleware that validates the session cookie against the `sessions` table and injects `X-User-Id`. - Every watchlist table/query is scoped by `us
